name: Afrânio (Brazil)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and white, the white charged with the municipal shield bearing a rising sun, a plant and a tree, over a scroll reading LUTAR E VENCER.
history: Afrânio is a municipality in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil.
